finalText.titleDe: Elektrische Summensignale bei ENG und EKG erklären
finalText.titleEn: Explain aggregate electrical signals in nerve conduction studies and ECG
finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann an gegebenen Modellen von ENG und EKG erklären, wie Oberflächenelektroden elektrische Spannungsunterschiede als Summensignal ableiten, wie ein angegebener Signalvergleich begrenzt zur Funktionsbeurteilung genutzt wird und warum daraus weder Einzelzellpotenziale noch ein Hirnbild oder eine eigenständige Diagnose folgen.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can use supplied models of nerve conduction studies (German ENG) and ECG to explain how surface electrodes record electrical potential differences as an aggregate signal, how a supplied signal comparison can support a bounded assessment of function, and why it gives neither single-cell membrane potentials nor a brain image or an independent diagnosis.

synthesis.synthesizedBy: Codex technical integration of actual sealed A/B science; model version not exposed
synthesis.rationaleDe: Technische Zusammenführung der echten unabhängig versiegelten A-/B-Erstbewertungen des gleichen vollständigen aktuellen bilingualen Ziels, nativer Seite und Quellen-/Bild-/Kontexteingänge. Alle originalen Records, Run-IDs und Campaign-IDs bleiben exakt. Keine neue fachliche Prüfung oder menschliche Freigabe. A: DE/EN identify surface electrical potential differences as an aggregate recording, bounded use of a supplied comparison, and limits concerning single cells, brain images and diagnosis. English disambiguates German ENG as nerve conduction studies. Original BY EA competence9 and the adjacent explicit ENG/EKG content support this bounded method model. Neither GA nor HE support is asserted. Cardiac tissue is distinguished from peripheral nerves rather than described as neurons. One competence explains aggregate surface electrical recording and bounded interpretation. ENG and ECG serve as contrasting applications of the same recording principle. The supplied speed/rate formulas are supports for interpreting the given model, not separately required calculation routines or clinical-method training. B: Both whole descriptions correctly describe a supplied extracellular surface-recording model and bounded interpretation. Peripheral nerve ENG and cardiac ECG have different tissue sources and uses; they are connected by one measurement principle and inference competence. The BY EA source explicitly names ENG and EKG under neurophysiological procedures, while GA omits that duty. BY-only LK applicability and partial e026 route are appropriate; HE requires a brain-imaging procedure, which this goal neither claims nor supplies.
synthesis.rationaleEn: Technical factual synthesis of genuine sealed independent A/B first-pass judgments over identical whole current bilingual goals, native pages and source/image/context inputs. Original records, runs and campaign identifiers are retained exactly. No new scientific review or human approval. A: In the supplied models, nerve conduction studies and ECG measure differences between surface electrode potentials arising from electrical cellular contributions weighted in space and time. Peripheral nerve conduction and cardiac electrical activity are distinct sources whose timing comparisons provide bounded information about function. B: Nerve conduction studies and ECG record electrical contributions distributed in space and time as a potential difference at surface electrodes; interpretation depends on tissue, recording model and context.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: ENG und EKG messen in den gegebenen Modellen Spannungsunterschiede zwischen Oberflächenelektroden aus räumlich und zeitlich gewichteten elektrischen Zellbeiträgen. Periphere Nervenleitung und elektrische Herzaktivität sind verschiedene Signalquellen; ihre zeitlichen Vergleiche liefern begrenzte Funktionshinweise.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: In the supplied models, nerve conduction studies and ECG measure differences between surface electrode potentials arising from electrical cellular contributions weighted in space and time. Peripheral nerve conduction and cardiac electrical activity are distinct sources whose timing comparisons provide bounded information about function.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die lernende Person erklärt das differentielle Summensignal, wertet vorgegebene Laufzeit- oder Rhythmusdaten mithilfe der bereitgestellten Regeln begründet aus und benennt den medizinischen Funktionsnutzen sowie die Grenzen gegenüber Einzelzellpotenzial, Hirnbild und Diagnose.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: The learner explains the differential aggregate signal, justifies an interpretation of supplied propagation or rhythm data using the provided rules, and identifies medical information about function and the limits concerning single-cell potentials, brain images and diagnosis.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Beim Wechsel vom peripheren Nervenmodell zum Herzmodell oder bei vertauschten Messleitungen passt die lernende Person Signalquelle und Auswertung an, erklärt die Polungsänderung ohne Gewebeänderung und unterscheidet einen zeitlichen Funktionsbefund von Gesundheit oder Krankheit.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: When transferring from a peripheral nerve model to a cardiac model or to swapped measurement leads, the learner adapts the source and interpretation, explains polarity reversal without tissue change, and distinguishes timing information about function from health or disease.

dissent.textDe: Die beiden aktuellen keep-Reviews unterscheiden sich in understandingEvidence, rationale, evidenceProfileRecommendation; das Manifest wählt ausdrücklich die Evidence-Fassung der ersten Runde.
dissent.textEn: The two current keep reviews differ in understandingEvidence, rationale, evidenceProfileRecommendation; the manifest explicitly selects the evidence formulation from the first round.
